text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: You know how we had a break? Well, my homeroom teacher started talking about extra classes…

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: She was all, like, threatening to speak with you if I didn't go.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: That's just as cringe as threatening to call my parents, right? So anyway, I went ham. Am I a model student or what?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It seems she didn't get much rest because she had to prepare for her extra classes. While I praise her for the hard work, I also advise her to pace her studies better in the future.
